specs.title: Booking agent reschedule and cancel
specs.why: Most real conversations are changes to existing bookings, not new ones.
specs.scope: Extend the agent with `find_booking`, `reschedule` and `cancel` tools. Refund behaviour respects the tenant cancellation policy.
tasks: Three new tools with tenant-scoped access
Conversation flows for identifying the right booking
acceptance: Cancelling inside the policy window triggers a refund
Cancelling outside the policy window keeps the deposit per rule
Rescheduling updates the booking and notifies the owner

specs.title: Agent guardrails
specs.why: An agent with booking and payment tools on a public channel is an attack surface and needs hardening before exposure.
specs.scope: Defences against prompt injection, cross-tenant tool calls, abuse and runaway usage. Add a human-handoff command. Per-sender rate limiting.
tasks: Rate limit per phone number (20 per minute)
Handoff command routes to the owner's number
acceptance: The red-team suite passes (injection, exfiltration, tool abuse)
The handoff command stops the agent and alerts the owner
